DTC P0325: Knock Sensor 1 Circuit Malfunction
CIRCUIT OPERATION
• The knock sensor sends a signal voltage to the 
ECM (terminal 91) <M/T> or PCM (terminal 90) 
<A/T>.
TECHNICAL DESCRIPTION
• The knock sensor converts the vibration of the 
cylinder block into a voltage and outputs it. If 
there is a malfunction of the knock sensor, the 
voltage output will not change.
• The ECM <M/T> or PCM <A/T> checks whether 
the voltage output changes.
